AI that does the hardest work in the hardest places.

Gritt is an intelligent system that combines robotics and AI to build the infrastructure that pulls society forward.

We need more infrastructure than the construction workforce can deliver.

Trillions of dollars in global infrastructure spending is planned. 41% of the U.S. construction workforce will retire by 2031. The gap is everywhere, on jobsites and in back offices. Humans alone can’t fill it.

AI-enabled construction ready for the real world.

Gritt is on-site building infrastructure with top ten US EPCs today. We’re just getting started.

An intelligent system.

Not just hardware. Not just AI. Gritt spans intelligence and robotics, all built with one of the world’s largest troves of spatial and operational data.

Starts with the hardest jobs. Extends across the full process.

Gritt handles pick-and-place, transport, and assembly across solar, concrete, and rebar. We’re expanding to cover verification and planning.

See our work in solar

Gritt works anywhere work happens.

Add Gritt to common equipment using off-the-shelf attachments and minimal custom hardware. Ready for dust, heat, cold, and any terrain.

One AI backbone for all construction work.

Construction work is five jobs in one. Gritt helps with all of them using the same intelligence. Starting in solar. Expanding to data center and large infrastructure.
